name: Wixoss Multiverse
summary: Wixoss Multiverse is an idle role-playing game based on the Wixoss trading card game. The player forms a party of up to six LRIGs and SIGNIs and sends it through a series of stages, where the characters move across the map and fight automatically. Units are obtained through a random draw and raised by clearing stages, which also unlocks equipment and skills for the protagonist. Over sixty characters from the card game and its anime adaptations are playable. Progress continues while the game is closed. It runs in a web browser on PC, tablet and smartphone with no installation.
